description: A phase correlation meter for two signals, with the correlation offered as a CV signal and its inverse

params.text: Sets the length of the window over which the two signals are compared, in samples; short windows suit audio rate signals and long ones suit slow signals
Attenuates the correlation and the inverted outputs
Offsets the correlation and the inverted outputs

inputs.text: Modulates the length of the comparison window
One of the two signals being compared
Modulates the offset applied to the correlation and inverted outputs
Modulates the attenuation applied to the correlation and inverted outputs

outputs.text: The correlation as a CV signal: positive while the two signals trend the same way across the window, negative while they trend opposite ways
The correlation with its sign inverted
A trigger at the end of each comparison window

notes: patch the two signals to be compared into the A and B inputs
menu: CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
Clamp CV Values keeps a value driven by CV inside the range of its knob; switched off, the value can go past that range
